previous_assumption: It might seem natural to add a separate `equipment.view` permission for read-only equipment actions (e.g. EquipmentService.listMachines) alongside `equipment.manage`.
correction: Decided against for MVP, per docs/equipment-domain-design.md §10: don't split view/manage permissions until a role actually needs read without write (nothing does yet — owner holds both). A stray `"equipment.view"` reference not present in the permissionCodeSchema enum surfaced as a real `tsc` error during EquipmentService implementation and was corrected back to `equipment.manage`, matching the other two permission checks in the same service.
